extraction.ocr_text:
Add evaluator
Select a type that corresponds to your needs.

×

○  LLM-as-a-judge: Semantic Similarity
   Create your own LLM-based evaluator.

○  Trajectory
   Create your own trajectory evaluator.

◉  Exact match
   Checks if the output precisely matches the expected output without any variations in wording,
   formatting.

○  JSON similarity
   Checking if two JSON structures or values are 'close enough' or share a similar
   structure/contents

○  CSV Column Exact Match   Preview
   Evaluates CSV output by matching exact values in specified columns against expected values

○  Context precision
   An evaluator that scores the relevancy of Context Grounding results to the user's query.

○  Faithfulness
   An evaluator that scores whether claims in the agent output are grounded in the provided
   context.

Cancel     Continue
extraction.description: The screenshot shows a UiPath Agents evaluator setup modal titled "Add evaluator." The dialog lists evaluator types, including LLM-as-a-judge, Trajectory, Exact match, JSON similarity, CSV Column Exact Match, Context precision, and Faithfulness. The "Exact match" deterministic evaluator option is selected and visually highlighted, with Cancel and Continue buttons available at the bottom.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the "Exact match" evaluator option if it is not already selected. Click on the "Continue" button to proceed with configuring the Exact match evaluator.
